latest_commit.message:
ai: make tool execution fail-safe

Wrap runtime tool execution inside aiToolRunner with a local try/catch.

If any runtime tool throws, SG now returns a structured tool output instead of crashing the whole AI response. The failed tool name and error message are logged for Render diagnostics.

This prevents errors from runGithubTool(...) from propagating through callAI() into the generic Telegram fallback.
